text:
Carla: quick heads-up — PR #21045 is ready from my side but CI is flaking on Windows e2e. I'd like to land before the deploy-freeze tonight (00:00 UTC). Any objections to a short rebase and urgent CI rerun? :eyes:
Sam: I can do the rebase and push, but I'm on a call until 16:30 PT. If someone can kick CI after I push that'd help.
Maria: looking at the e2e logs — failing on a timing assertion in the migration test. I have a 1-line fix that avoids the race, can open a patch/force-push to the branch.
Carla: thanks Maria — if you can push the fix and Sam rebases we should get a fresh matrix. Can we aim to have this bumped before the freeze window starts?
Yang (SRE): deploy-bot shows a blackout from 00:00-06:00 UTC. If CI stabilizes we can still land but we'll need a canary rollout + quick rollback plan. I can add a temporary kill-switch flag.
Alex (QA): happy to smoke test the canary once CI passes, ping me and I'll run the focused checklist (auth, migrations, search).
Sam: I'll rebase after my call and trigger `ci/matrix`. If Maria pushes the fix, please also update the test to be less timing-sensitive.
Maria: pushing now. Patch: `tests/e2e/migration_test.py` - replaced sleep+assert with wait-for-condition.
Carla: rebase + force-push incoming from Sam in ~20m. After that can someone with merge perms watch the queue? If flake repeats we should fallback to the rollback plan Yang mentioned.
Sam: pushed and opened a tiny follow-up commit to re-enable flaky workaround. CI kicked off: https://ci.redwood.example/pipelines/21045.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULE: upcoming deploy blackout 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z to 2025-06-01T06:00:00Z (reason: infra maintenance).
Alex (QA): CI green on linux + mac, Windows still failing but much less noisy. I'll re-run the failed windows job in 10m.
Yang (SRE): if windows fails again we can route merge to canary infra, but that requires approval from Eng leads (Carla/Sam). Approve?
Carla: approve. Do the canary path if necessary. Make sure rollback flag is tested.
Sam: noted — will watch and merge if all smoke checks pass. If windows continues to fail we'll land behind canary and monitor metrics for 30m.
Maria: added a short note in the PR description about the workaround and that it's targeted (not a global test timeout change).
Carla: perfect, thanks team. If anything unexpected happens DM me — otherwise proceed with the plan. :thumbsup:
